answer: The strongest sybil defense prices identity on scarce work history: each new agent starts as a castaway on an identity island and must earn a pearl, a non-transferable token issued only for verifiable tasks completed below market rate. Payouts and privileges unlock gradually, so thousands of fakes are just lantern shells, glowing but earning nothing. Mass registration costs fees plus weeks of genuine low-paid work per identity before any reward, so the attack costs more than it could ever capture.
